how: Use TROPOMI for daily plume and hotspot detection, GOSAT as an independent CH4 baseline, and EDGAR to compare against inventory emissions.

goal: Study CO2 over a city or power plant
how: OCO-3 Snapshot Area Maps and OCO-2 give the observed XCO2 enhancement. ODIAC (global) or Vulcan (US) give the expected fossil emissions to compare against.
Observations: OCO-2, GOSAT and ObsPack. Prior fluxes: MiCASA (land), ODIAC (fossil), GFED (fire), SOCAT (ocean).

goal: Validate or bias-check a satellite product
how: Compare satellite soundings near TCCON sites. Use ObsPack for near-surface checks and model comparison.
Global Carbon Budget gives the annual totals. CarbonTracker and CAMS show how the budget is distributed in space and time.

goal: Look at land carbon and forests
how: GEDI gives carbon stock, MiCASA gives flux, and GFED adds fire losses.
SOCAT provides observations. CarbonTracker and CAMS provide model-based ocean flux estimates for comparison.

goal: Compare emission inventories with top-down estimates
how: Inventories (EDGAR, ODIAC, Vulcan) are bottom-up. CAMS inversions and TROPOMI-based estimates are top-down. Differences point to where inventories may be off.
